The [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] '''Searcher 2050 Exploration Droid''' was a spherical [[Explorer droid/Legends|exploration droid]].

==Characteristics==
A small spherical droid similar to a [[remote]] or [[seeker]], the Searcher 2050 was advanced enough to have a personality and degree of thought. Commonly used for scouting (like many [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]]), the Searcher 2050 was also a capable pilot, and was programmed to operate a wide range of [[Planet/Legends|ground]] and [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] vehicles, as well as their weapon systems, through an integrated [[Scomp link/Legends|Scomp link]].

==History==
The [[Oridium]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of [[Gavos system/Legends|Gavos]] used Searcher 2050s for scouting mines and piloting [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]]. One such unit was [[Lookout (droid)|Lookout]], who, though part of the [[New Droids' Rights Movement]], was nonetheless unconvinced for the need of a [[Droid rebellion]].
